title: Seedream 4.0 joins image generation
summary:
Seedream 4.0 arrived, text models changed routes, and paid-generation checks got stricter.

Three PRs added the seed-tier `seedream` model for text-to-image and reference-image generation. Requests ask for watermark-free output, with a configured maximum side length of 2048 pixels. Image analytics also now records the requested settings instead of fixed defaults.

`openai-large` now routes seed-tier users to GPT-5 Chat, also available as `gpt-5-chat`. `openai` now aliases `openai-fast` on GPT-4.1 Nano. `openai-audio` accepts up to 5,000 input characters, up from 2,000.

Enter now checks for an active session and a positive Pollen balance before forwarding paid text or image requests; free-model requests remain available without that check. Cached responses are not charged, and `POST /openai` is accepted alongside `/openai/chat/completions`.

daily.title: Seedream 4.0 images
daily.text: Generate images from a prompt or provide a reference image with the seed-tier `seedream` model. Its requests ask for output without a watermark. [Explore Seedream](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=seedream).

daily.title: GPT-5 Chat routing
daily.text: Seed-tier users can use GPT-5 Chat through `openai-large` or the `gpt-5-chat` alias. The `openai` alias now points to `openai-fast` on GPT-4.1 Nano. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gpt-5-chat).

daily.title: Longer audio input
daily.text: `openai-audio` now accepts up to 5,000 input characters, up from 2,000. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai-audio).

daily.title: Shorter OpenAI route
daily.text: Send requests to `POST /openai` as an alternative to `/openai/chat/completions`. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
